findings.description: Discovery worker is resumed before rollback-sensitive readiness/identity/count postchecks. A failure thereafter can enter rollback and recreate services even if discovery created an ACTIVE run, since exception path has no intake stop/idle or drain guard.
findings.requestedFix: Perform identity/count checks before discovery resumes; exception after resumed discovery must stop discovery and wait/recheck idle before any image/source rollback, otherwise leave intake paused for manual recovery.
findings.resolution: Switched exception re-pauses public intake, stops only discovery and checks active runs/running tasks/running attempts/unsafe effects before image, build, source or service recreation. If new work exists, assertion leaves application pools intact and public intake paused for manual recovery. Explicit rollback script applies equivalent guard before restoring the trial.
